zombie.name: zombie process
man: Died, but was never reaped. Still holds its rifle and its PID.
Hitscan: when it takes aim (red !) its next shot cannot be dodged.
Kill it first, or put a wall between you. It misses more at range.

sudo.name: sudo zombie
sudo.death: %s is reaped. Its privileges go with it.
man: A zombie that once had sudo. It still believes it does.
Three pellets at once; deadly up close, poor at a distance.
Keep your distance, or get to it before it takes aim.

orphan.name: orphan
man: Lost its parent process. Found something else instead.
Raises a burning hand (orange !), then throws fire at where you stand.
The fire flies a cell a beat: step out of its way.
It burns whatever it meets first - and that one will not forgive.

daemon.name: daemon
man: Ran in the background until it smelt you.
Melee charger: a cell a beat, then teeth.
Shotgun it up close, or back off and let something else hit it.

spawner.name: spawner
spawner.death: %s bursts. Its children are orphans now.
man: fork(), fork(), fork(). It never waits for its children.
Every few beats it spawns a lost+found soul, up to three at a time.
Kill it first; the souls are only its noise.

soul.name: lost+found soul
man: Fragments nobody claimed, burning with resentment.
Flies two cells a beat and bites. Ten health: one good hit.

barrel.name: barrel
man: Pressurised coolant, gone bad.
Bursts for 40 at everything next to it - you too, within one cell.

cron.name: Cron

attack.wake_text: Cron opens its eye. Its hands begin to turn. crontab -l:

enraged.text: Cron rewrites its crontab: */2. It is in a hurry now.

text: Cron's hands spin backwards. Its face cracks.
crond: job rescheduled for the end of time.

man: CRON(8) - the daemon that keeps time. It was here before root, and it means to outlast it.
It does not chase. It schedules: every few beats fire falls on a pattern of
the floor - marked a beat ahead. Read the crontab, step off the marked floor.
It forks lost+found souls to keep you busy. Hurt it enough and it rewrites
its own schedule. Nobody has ever seen it die.

kworker.name: kworker
man: A kernel worker with its cables out and a pistol in hand. Always busy.
Dodges: it may sidestep a shot it sees coming, at two cells or more.
Up close it cannot - and a shotgun's spread finds it anyway.

kswapd.name: kswapd
man: Swaps you out of memory with a drum of slugs. Slow: it moves every other beat.
Three shots a burst. When it takes aim (red !), break the line or close in.

shred.name: shred
man: Overwrites what it finds, then burns the copy.
Sprays fire three cells along a row or a column - only when you are in line.
When it levels its nozzle (orange !), step out of the line. The fire stays a few beats.
Its tanks burst when it dies. Do not stand beside it, or on oil.

crawler.name: crawler
man: Indexes everything it can reach, three red eyes first.
Fast: two cells a beat. Weak: one shotgun blast up close ends it.

spinlock.name: spinlock
man: Holds the lock and will not let go.
Spins up for two beats (red !!), then fires every beat while it sees you.
Break its line of sight - a wall, a crate - and the barrels wind down.

loader.name: cargo loader

vehicle.board: You strap into the loader's cage. Space: claw. Walk into them: tread. Enter: climb down.
vehicle.leave: You unstrap and drop down out of the cage. The loader stands where you left it.
vehicle.wreck: The loader's hydraulics burst. You tumble out of the cage as it goes up.

man: LD(8) - the facility's cargo loader. It links what arrives to where it is needed.
Walk into it to climb in. It wades through acid, treads on what is in its way,
shoves containers you cannot move, and takes the hits instead of you - 150 of them.
It will not go through doors. Enter climbs down. When it gives out, it blows up.
